rows.verified: Product-alert relevance depends on exact model, batch, defect, jurisdiction, user, use conditions, corrective action and publication status.

rows.source: OPSS unsafe-product alerts and recalls
rows.verified: OPSS alerts are product- and incident-specific and must not be converted directly into parcel-level harm probability.

rows.source: MHRA medicine and medical-device safety communications
rows.verified: MHRA's Drug Safety Update publishes safety advice for medicines and medical practice.

rows.source: MHRA medicine and medical-device safety communications
rows.verified: The service can be searched and subscribed to by email or feed.

rows.source: MHRA medicine and medical-device safety communications
rows.verified: Drug Safety Update entries identify the medicine or product and the relevant safety action or warning.

rows.source: MHRA medicine and medical-device safety communications
rows.verified: MHRA maintains alerts, recalls and safety information for medicines and medical devices.

rows.source: MHRA medicine and medical-device safety communications
rows.verified: The alert service distinguishes medicines recalls or notifications, field safety notices and safety roundups.

rows.source: MHRA medicine and medical-device safety communications
rows.verified: Medicines defect notices can identify affected products and batches and describe the defect.

rows.source: MHRA medicine and medical-device safety communications
rows.verified: Medical-device field safety notices are published in dated collections.

rows.source: MHRA medicine and medical-device safety communications
rows.verified: Alert records include issue dates and relevant medical specialisms.

rows.source: MHRA medicine and medical-device safety communications
rows.verified: Medicine or device risk depends on product, batch, indication, dose, patient, user, defect, corrective action and clinical context.

rows.source: MHRA medicine and medical-device safety communications
rows.verified: MHRA communications are product-, batch-, patient-, user-, action- and time-specific and are not an exact parcel-level harm probability.

rows.source: CAA dangerous-goods and lithium-battery safety
rows.verified: CAA dangerous-goods guidance covers incident reporting, training, approvals, lithium batteries and portable electronic devices.

rows.source: CAA dangerous-goods and lithium-battery safety
rows.verified: A lithium-battery fire in an aircraft hold is a significant safety risk.

rows.source: CAA dangerous-goods and lithium-battery safety
rows.verified: Incorrect packing, marking, labelling and undeclared or misdeclared batteries have featured in incidents.

rows.source: CAA dangerous-goods and lithium-battery safety
rows.verified: Lithium batteries must be packed, marked, labelled and documented under applicable ICAO Technical Instructions.

rows.source: CAA dangerous-goods and lithium-battery safety
rows.verified: Transport of lithium batteries on their own is forbidden in the hold of passenger aircraft.

rows.source: CAA dangerous-goods and lithium-battery safety
rows.verified: CAA published passenger and operator rule changes effective from 27 March 2026.

rows.source: CAA dangerous-goods and lithium-battery safety
rows.verified: Damaged, abused, poorly manufactured or inadequately tested lithium batteries can catch fire or explode.

rows.source: CAA dangerous-goods and lithium-battery safety
rows.verified: CAA guidance calls for risk management, acceptance checks, segregation, training and incident reporting across the transport chain.

rows.source: CAA dangerous-goods and lithium-battery safety
rows.verified: Lithium-battery aviation risk depends on chemistry, rating, manufacture, damage, packing, baggage location, cargo handling, operator controls and flight context.

rows.source: CAA dangerous-goods and lithium-battery safety
rows.verified: CAA dangerous-goods evidence is battery-, shipment-, passenger-, operator-, aircraft-, control- and time-specific and is not a parcel-level fire probability.

rows.source: ORR railway safety management, reporting and public protection
rows.verified: ROGS provides the regulatory regime for safety on railways, tramways and other guided transport systems in Great Britain.

rows.source: ORR railway safety management, reporting and public protection
rows.verified: Most transport operators must maintain a safety management system and hold an accepted safety certificate or authorisation.

rows.source: ORR railway safety management, reporting and public protection
rows.verified: Safety management systems define roles, safety arrangements, worker involvement and continuous improvement.

rows.source: ORR railway safety management, reporting and public protection
rows.verified: Serious reportable railway incidents must be notified by the quickest practical means and followed by written notification within 10 days.

rows.source: ORR railway safety management, reporting and public protection
rows.verified: Occupational diseases reportable to ORR must be notified without delay.

rows.source: ORR railway safety management, reporting and public protection
rows.verified: ORR states that trespass is associated with most public deaths on Britain's railways.

rows.source: ORR railway safety management, reporting and public protection
rows.verified: Infrastructure controllers must take reasonably practicable steps to prevent unauthorised access and control materials that could be used for vandalism.

rows.source: ORR railway safety management, reporting and public protection
rows.verified: Train-protection systems can automatically apply brakes after excessive-speed approaches or signals passed at danger.

rows.source: ORR railway safety management, reporting and public protection
rows.verified: Rail risk depends on infrastructure, rolling stock, signalling, traffic, maintenance, competence, public behaviour, reporting and operational context.

rows.source: ORR railway safety management, reporting and public protection
rows.verified: ORR railway evidence is operator-, route-, asset-, worker-, passenger-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level incident probability.
